description:
Team Myles O’Donoghue are pleased to introduce this well presented two bedroom mid terrace property to the market, situated in the established and popular Fernleigh development.

Offering well balanced accommodation, the property is has been modernised and presented in excellent condition, and, provides an excellent opportunity for a first time buyer, someone looking to downsize, or an investor seeking a well-located property.

The ground floor comprises an entrance hall with a downstairs guest cloakroom with WC, to the front there is a kitchen / breakfast Room.  To the rear there is a bright and spacious living room with timber flooring.  From the living room, there is access to the south facing rear garden, which provides a private outdoor space and also benefits from a garden shed, ideal for additional storage.

Upstairs, the property provides two spacious double bedrooms.  The main bedroom has the added benefit of an en-suite, while the second bedroom is serviced by the main family bathroom. 

The location is one of the property's key attractions. Fernleigh is situated just off Diswellstown Road, with a wide selection of everyday amenities and services available nearby. There are a number of primary and secondary schools, crèches, and Doctor Surgeries in the surrounding area, as well as Technological University Dublin – Blanchardstown Campus.

There is also an excellent choice of sporting and recreational facilities close to the property, including Porterstown Park, Coolmine Sports & Leisure Centre, the National Aquatic Centre and the Phoenix Park. Blanchardstown Centre is only a short distance away and provides an extensive selection of retail, leisure and dining facilities, as well as Draíocht Arts Centre and Blanchardstown Library.

Commuters are well catered for, with the 37 bus route providing regular connections towards Dublin City Centre. Coolmine Train Station is also within walking distance, providing rail services towards Dublin and Maynooth and making the property particularly convenient for those travelling to work or study.
This is a well located home offering comfortable accommodation, a private rear garden and excellent access to local amenities and transport links.
